text:
maria: Quick sync — staging handoff for SDK v1.9 + sampleapps. We hit the branch freeze but still have 3 outstanding sampleapp PRs and one docs update. Who's owning final merges and the changelog pin?

sam: I can take the SDK PRs (pkg & tests) — will finish reviews in the next 90 mins. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412, /413

priyanka: I'll own the docs pin. I'm waiting on a single API wording confirmation from eng-runtime. If someone from runtime can weigh in we'll cut the docs commit.

lucas: runtime ack — small wording: replace "kv-cache hit" -> "KV cache hit" in the samples page. PR comment left on priyanka's doc draft.

andy: thx. who can handle the two sampleapp merge conflicts? One is a test fixture bump, other is the new quickstart readme. If unresolved, we'll delay packaging.

maria: @sam can you also take the fixture bump? It's in the sampleapp repo but it's due to SDK test helpers change; cross-repo merge.

sam: yep I'll do the fixture bump. For the quickstart readme conflict I can do a light merge but need confirmation on the code snippet to keep (old vs new auth example).

priyanka: new auth example is the intended standard. tag @lucas for final check.

lucas: confirmed new auth example. keep the snippet with env var example and remove the legacy oauth block.

ci-bot: [pipeline] staging/build #1987 started by sam — running unit tests and integration smoke.

sam: FYI tests flaked in integration on node 14 matrix, rerunning flaky job now.

maria: For changelog: we'll consolidate SDK entries + sampleapp highlights into a single "devex" section. @andy can you do the final changelog commit message since you own release notes formatting?

andy: I will. Please drop final bullet points here once merges are green. Need the exact phrasing for the sampleapp highlights (1-2 lines each).

priyanka: Draft bullets: "Updated quickstart auth to env var flow; improved sampleapp test fixtures to reduce flakiness; docs clarified KV cache behavior." Thoughts?

maria: that's great. Minor tweak: change "reduced flakiness" -> "reduced CI flakes for sampleapp tests".

sam: merge complete for SDK PRs and fixture bump. integration smoke now passed.

ci-bot: [pipeline] staging/build #1987 passed — all checks green.

andy: pulling the changelog together now. I'll push the final changelog commit to staging/changelog-2026-03-17 and tag for release candidate. Expect a final commit in ~15m.

maria: amazing — once changelog is up priyanka please cut the docs commit and i'll trigger the staging deploy. Thanks all! :rocket:
